Why choose .JPN.COM?

  • UNMATCHED AVAILABILITY – A RARE DIGITAL OPPORTUNITY

    With over a million .jp and .co.jp domains already taken, securing a short, brandable domain is challenging. .JPN.COM offers fresh opportunities with premium domain availability in an unrestricted namespace.

  • GLOBAL TRUST, LOCAL RECOGNITION

    Leverage the credibility of .COM with the local relevance of Japan. Whether you are a Japanese company expanding internationally or a global brand entering the Japanese market, .JPN.COM builds trust with both customers and search engines.

  • SEO & MARKET VISIBILITY

    Our intent with .JPN.COM is to be search engine-friendly, offering a .COM alternative specifically designed for businesses engaging with Japan. .JPN.COM provides localized market relevance without the eligibility barriers of traditional ccTLDs.

  • NO RESIDENCY OR BUSINESS RESTRICTIONS

    Unlike .jp and .co.jp, which require Japanese residency, business registration, or legal compliance, .JPN.COM is open to all registrants worldwide. This allows businesses to secure their domain names freely and without bureaucratic hurdles.

  • IDEAL FOR BUSINESS EXPANSION & INTERNATIONAL REACH

    Whether you are a Japanese business looking for international branding or a global company entering Japan, .JPN.COM provides a flexible domain solution that adapts to both local and global markets.

.JPN.COM – Your gateway to Japan’s digital economy

The internet connects businesses and individuals across borders, and Japan is a key player in the global digital economy. .JPN.COM offers a powerful and unrestricted domain option for companies, entrepreneurs, and investors looking to establish a strong online presence in Japan while maintaining international flexibility.

Unlike country-code TLDs (ccTLDs) like .jp and .co.jp, which have eligibility restrictions requiring local residency or business registration, .JPN.COM is open to everyone. Whether you’re an international company expanding into Japan, a Japanese business looking for a global presence, or a startup targeting the Japanese market, .JPN.COM provides a seamless and accessible solution.

.JPN.COM operates independently and has no affiliation with the Japanese government, .JP, or .COM. We are an autonomous entity providing an unrestricted and globally accessible domain space.

.JPN.COM vs. Other Japanese Domain Options

Establish your digital presence in Japan

Japan is home to a highly connected and rapidly growing digital economy, with millions of online consumers and businesses looking for trusted brands and services. .JPN.COM gives companies a direct path to online success in Japan—without the regulatory barriers of traditional ccTLDs.

Your domain name is more than just an address—it’s your identity, your brand, and your connection to Japan’s thriving economy. Whether you’re launching a business, expanding into Japan, or building your online presence, .JPN.COM is the smart choice for reaching both local and international audiences.

Register your .JPN.COM domain today

Looking for a domain that offers both global reach and local relevance? Secure your .JPN.COM domain today and take advantage of unrestricted access to Japan’s digital market.
